preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'val'))
preconditions.description: The input root is either None or a valid TreeNode with left, right, and val attributes.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (all(isinstance(node, type(root)) or node is None for node in [root.left, root.right]))
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree are of the same type as root or None, ensuring structural consistency.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of vaccine kits.

The return value equals the minimum number of houses that must be supplied with vaccine kits such that every house in the tree is covered by at least one kit, where a kit at a node covers the node, its parent, and its immediate children.
